name: repo-polish
description: Audit and improve open-source repository presentation, onboarding, trust, and community health.

interface.shortDescription: Make repositories clear, trusted, and contribution-ready
interface.longDescription: An evidence-first repository audit and improvement workflow for README structure, bilingual presentation, onboarding, trust signals, community files, visual hierarchy, and GitHub metadata.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository and propose the smallest high-value polish improvements.
Make this project open-source ready with clear bilingual documentation and verified trust signals.
